Theorem rhmkerinj 20588
Description: A ring homomorphism is injective if and only if its kernel is zero. (Contributed by Jeff Madsen, 16-Jun-2011.) (Revised by AV, 24-Jul-2026.)
Hypotheses
Ref Expression
rhmkerinj.b ⊢ 𝐵 = (Base‘𝑅)
rhmkerinj.c ⊢ 𝐶 = (Base‘𝑆)
rhmkerinj.0 ⊢ 0 = (0g‘𝑅)
rhmkerinj.z ⊢ 𝑍 = (0g‘𝑆)
Assertion
Ref Expression
rhmkerinj ⊢ (𝐹 ∈ (𝑅 RingHom 𝑆) → (𝐹:𝐵–1-1→𝐶 ↔ (◡𝐹 “ {𝑍}) = { 0 }))
